item.title: The Flightless Birds of the Cape Peninsula
item.description: Explore Cape Town, take a guided tour to enjoy all the activities from the Cape Point Ostrich Farm to the must-see Penguin colony on Boulders Beach.

item.title: How to Check and Pay Cape Town Traffic Fines in 2026
item.description: Check your City of Cape Town traffic fines online and pay them with PayThat, your banking app, at Checkers, Pick n Pay and other stores, or at a City office. What happens if you don’t pay.
